title: the-instance-address-is-resolved-never-spelled
intention: Make the instance address PHYSICS: a component that spells ~/.cairn by hand instead of asking cairn.tools.base.address is refused at the build inspection, and the seven standing hand-spellings go to zero first so the gate lands on a corpus it does not immediately red. Two halves, in that order. (a) CONVERT ALL SEVEN — four in aider_shim (driver.DEFAULT_DRIVES, fence.DEFAULT_RECORD, venv.VENV, probes/offload_yield_probe.ASK_LOG), ground_loop/discovery.instance_devices_root, and the two the probe called its permanent FLOOR: build_inspector/inspector.py:216 (resolve('instance/devices') has always been the device-across-instances shape, and the import allowlist that held it back was retired on 2026-08-12) and inference_domain/route.py:44 (ruled, and carrying a migration of live state — ~/.cairn/inference/hosts.json moves to ~/.cairn/devices/inference_domain/0/). (b) THE GATE — a new build_inspector sieve, one boolean per component, source-level and inference-free, composing the probe's existing scan rather than writing a second copy of the rule. Then the probe's floor drops to zero and base's charter loses the clause that says nothing refuses an eleventh spelling.
why: THE LIVED SYMPTOM: a resolver nobody is refused for ignoring is a convenience, and the corpus regrows the defect it was built to end. MEASURED, not predicted — on 2026-08-12 ten hand-spelled instance paths were converted down to two; on 2026-08-17 the armed probe measures SEVEN across 162 files and _enough() returns False. One new spelling per day for five days, four of them written by CC inside aider_shim, the device it was actively building, while the probe that names them sat armed and never fired. The cost is the one the resolver's own charter states: provisioning instance 1 of anything means finding and editing every copy, and a shipped app whose root is not under this developer's home directory cannot run at all. AND THE SHARPER WHY, which is about the disposition and not the paths: the probe's floor of two named both sites and both reasons, and both reasons had gone stale — one was answered by a function that predates the probe, the other by a ruling Akien made the same day, recorded two hundred lines away in the same component. A watch whose floor is never re-read goes on clearing against a world that moved.
traces_to: Law 4, by name and in its own words — 'a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy; until it is, it is a tracked debt (an IOU), not a resting state.' base's charter clause (8) states that debt verbatim ('nothing REFUSES an eleventh hand-spelled path... The enforcement is a tracked debt, not a resting state'), so this pays a declared IOU rather than opening a new rule. Law 1 — the resolver exists so a settled address is not re-derived; without a door the re-derivation continued, five times in five days. Law 9 — the red was measured and a deterministic red is fixed or carries a ruling, never a paragraph. Law 3 for the honesty of the close: the probe is the instrument, and the count must read zero by measurement, never by the floor being edited to match.

falsifier.proves_green: prove_gate: teeth beside the code at cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/ (the sieve), cairn/tools/base/proofs/ (the corpus reading) and cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/ (the migrated overlay read), each sealed by the tester under netns isolation and persisted through validation_store.persist_validation — the store's own door, never a hand-written trail (a live trouble is on file for that breach, and it recurred twice after being cleared, so it is named rather than assumed). check-type deterministic throughout: the sieve is inference-free by the inspector's own contract, and `cairn determinism` must still read the module PURE DETERMINISTIC after the addition. feedback_gate: a red routes to build_inspector for the sieve half and to cairn/tools/base for the resolver half — never to a converted caller, since every conversion is a mechanical substitution of one expression for an equal one.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when all four hold. (a) survey_class_space() reports ZERO sites on a scan that read more than zero files — the count and its denominator together, because a vacuous scan reports zero for the wrong reason. (b) _FLOOR_SITES is empty and _enough() returns True, read from the LIVE corpus and not from a fixture. (c) A PLANTED EIGHTH SPELLING REDS THE INSPECTION — the tooth a hollow build cannot pass, because a sieve that never fires is indistinguishable from no sieve, and after a successful conversion the corpus offers no live offender to demonstrate it on. (d) The two hardest conversions are proved at their own seams: route.py reads hosts.json from the new address, and the offload probe's ASK_LOG equals fence.DEFAULT_RECORD by Path equality rather than by two spellings agreeing. WRONG INTENT if the exemption set cannot be stated as a rule rather than a list of names — the scan must skip address.py, the watcher's own file and proofs/, all three sayable as 'a file whose job is to name or to assert the rule is not an instance of it'. A fourth exemption that cannot be said that way means the sieve has become the hand-widened allowlist that ticket reachability-replaces-the-allowlist retired at this same address, and the honest disposition is to route back to the AST shape.
falsifier.horizon: one build for the falsifier. The watch's horizon is the first component built after this that needs instance state — its author either reaches for instance_path or gets redded, and which one happens is the reading. That has a scheduled arrival rather than a hope: the queued inference-task log is itself a component about to need an instance address, and it is next in the sail batch.
